PartyMonitor.Name: Party sheet monitoring
PartyMonitor.Hint: Monitor party sheets: members, currency and shared inventory.

MonitorHP.Name: Monitor HP
MonitorHP.Hint: Current, maximum, temporary and temporary maximum HP.

MonitorLevel.Name: Monitor level
MonitorLevel.Hint: Class levels, including adding and removing a class.

MonitorSpellPrep.Name: Monitor spell preparation
MonitorSpellPrep.Hint: A spell becomes prepared, not prepared or always prepared.

MonitorSpellSlots.Name: Monitor spell slots
MonitorSpellSlots.Hint: Spent and recovered slots and their maximum, pact magic included.

MonitorCurrency.Name: Monitor currency
MonitorCurrency.Hint: Currency on the sheet and in containers.

MonitorPartyMembers.Name: Monitor party members
MonitorPartyMembers.Hint: A member is added to or removed from a party.

MonitorEffects.Name: Monitor active effects
MonitorEffects.Hint: An effect is added, removed, enabled or disabled.

MonitorItemQuantity.Name: Monitor items
MonitorItemQuantity.Hint: An item is added or removed, or its quantity changes.

MonitorItemNameDesc.Name: Monitor item names and descriptions
MonitorItemNameDesc.Hint: Renamed items and description changes, shown as a diff. Comparing long descriptions takes some work on weak computers.

MonitorItemEquip.Name: Monitor equipment
MonitorItemEquip.Hint: An item is equipped or unequipped.

MonitorItemAttune.Name: Monitor attunement
MonitorItemAttune.Hint: Attunement to an item is gained or lost.

MonitorItemIdentify.Name: Monitor identification
MonitorItemIdentify.Hint: An item is identified or becomes unidentified.

MonitorItemCharges.Name: Monitor charges
MonitorItemCharges.Hint: Spent and recovered uses of items and features, and their maximum.

MonitorItemContainer.Name: Monitor containers
MonitorItemContainer.Hint: An item is moved into, out of or between containers.

MonitorSheetMode.Name: Monitor sheet mode
MonitorSheetMode.Hint: The sheet switches between play and edit mode. Needs libWrapper.

BatchMs.Name: Batch time (ms)
BatchMs.Hint: Changes of one character are collected for this long, counted from the first one, and then sent together. Each change is still its own message.

ShowAuthorMark.Name: Mark changes made by others
ShowAuthorMark.Hint: A small crown (GM) or pen (player) in the corner of a message when somebody else made the change. Who and when are in the tooltip of the icon. Affects only you.

HideOwnChanges.Name: Hide my changes
HideOwnChanges.Hint: Hides messages about changes you made yourself. Affects only you.

ContextMenu.ClearConfirm: Delete all monitor messages ({count})? This cannot be undone.
